text: Day ten. A reel tells you: every successful person wakes up at five. Movies love this. The CEO jogging in the dark. The topper studying at dawn. {neutral} But here's what the science says. In twenty nineteen, researchers studied the D N A of nearly seven lakh people. They found three hundred fifty-one spots in our genes linked to being a morning person... or a night owl. So if five A M feels like torture... that's not laziness. Part of it is written in you.
